title: Private Kelowna Wine Adventure
includes: Tasting fees are included at all wineries we visit.
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Discover the true essence of wine country on the West Kelowna Afternoon Wine Tour. Set against the backdrop of Mount Boucherie, renowned for its rich volcanic soil, this tour takes you through the finest vineyards where you can savor exceptional wines. Guided by experts, the journey caters to both connoisseurs and novices, ensuring an unforgettable experience filled with the heritage of winemaking. Enjoy a curated selection of wines while learning the stories behind each sip, making this tour a perfect choice for wine enthusiasts and casual tasters alike.

- Explore the stunning vineyards around Mount Boucherie
- Enjoy expert guidance tailored to your wine knowledge level
- Savor exceptional wines with stories behind each selection
- Perfect for both wine connoisseurs and curious novices alike
